status: Frozen before new outcome fits; implementation checks may fix errors without selecting model settings.

attribution.shared_inputs: Identical profiled I,U,V and tau grid for the pooled versus unpooled score comparison. Same likelihood and background shell for SuSiE.
attribution.pooling_ablation: Each readout estimates pi,tau separately on the common training-derived grid. No per-readout grid change.
attribution.averaging_ablation: Keep pooled fitted pi,tau; replace posterior support averaging by the most probable support component mean.
attribution.interpretation: SuSiE has a different prior family; its residual gap cannot be uniquely attributed to exact inference.

normal.MCSE: Paired replicate-cluster delta-method ratio-of-mean risks, not a mean of per-draw percentages.

spatial.geometry: New independent synthetic source and receiver point clouds, not the two development chips. Train/test generated separately.
spatial.positive_noise: Gamma with shape4, heteroskedastic positive branch
spatial.primary: conditional mean and complete source-effect recovery, equal block weights
spatial.residual: smooth spatial random field with lengthscale250um, independent across train/test; same realized field in source-zero truth

sensitivity.scope: First four preassigned replicates of each non-null spatial setting; descriptive, no retuning.

native.prediction: Fit both training chips combined with chip-prefixed blocks; freeze estimates before viewing test errors. Also report separate train-chip directions, without selecting one.
native.receivers: No detected barcode; RNA count100..6000, source neighborhood100um and supported block rule retained from development; not confirmed unperturbed cells.
native.primary: Equal-block observed count prediction error source-on versus fitted source-zero and independently fitted background-only
native.secondary: Uncentered and centered block error; native effect energy and restricted permutation p-values; no claim that centered error is deployable prediction.
native.support_scope: Descriptive predeclared eligibility, not a power theorem; all readouts retained, unsupported comparisons labeled.
native.replication: New chip from same study; animal identities not inferred from coordinate components. Not an independent laboratory cohort.
native.permutation_scope: Only if label strata and support permit. New draws from actual source labels; no reuse of the old99 cached permutations.

independent_cohort: Retry Perturb-FISH processed THP1. Audit Perturb-DBiT before eligibility. Do not substitute spot-level mixtures or one pooled Xenium sample for independently replicated single-cell source effects.
reporting: Preserve all failures and unfavorable results. Freeze remains unchanged after reading results. Report timings, platform, package versions, Monte Carlo uncertainty; distinguish descriptive shrinkage activation from calibrated hypothesis tests.
